propositions: Checkbox-state normalization (case-insensitive x, -, * bullets normalized to '[ ]' pre-hash) was implemented in commit 330c but not documented, leaving docs/plan-review-gate.md describing the old behavior where any description edit invalidates attestations.
The invalidation rules section (~L469) must be updated to explicitly state that checkbox-state flips are normalized out of the material fingerprint and only item-text edits invalidate attestations.
The AC-checkbox completeness precheck section (~L901) must note that checking boxes to satisfy the precheck does not invalidate the plan-review attestation due to checkbox-state normalization.
Documentation across docs/ (user-guide.md, completion-verifier docs) must be audited to remove or align any claims that checkbox flips stale a review.
